test_title: SSC CGL 2024 Tier-I Official Paper (Held On: 25 Sept, 2024 Shift 2)
subject: general
question:
Select the most appropriate option that can substitute the underlined part in the following sentence.

We all have to __pull our socks up__ for the upcoming Board exam, if we want to get outstanding grades.
solution: The correct answer is: **Option 2**. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** __ • The phrase **"pull our socks up"** means to make an effort to improve your work or behavior because it is not good enough. (अपनी मेहनत में सुधार करना) • **Example: **After the poor performance in the last match, the team needs to pull their socks up if they want to win the tournament. • **"Work harder than before"** refers to putting in more effort than previously to achieve better results. (पहले से अधिक मेहनत करना) • **Example: **To secure a top rank in the competitive exam, students need to work harder than before. • Hence, we can infer that the phrase "pull our socks up" is best substituted by "work harder than before". Therefore, the correct answer is: **Option 2**. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__** Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences: • **Act in a proper manner** (सही तरीके से कार्य करना): Behaving appropriately according to the situation. • **Example:** You must act in a proper manner when attending a formal event. • **Calm down impudent contempt** (ढीठ अवमानना को शांत करना): To reduce or control bold disrespect. • **Example:** The teacher had to calm down the impudent contempt shown by some students during the lecture. • **Revive interest in old matters** (पुराने मामलों में रुचि को पुनर्जीवित करना): To make people interested in subjects that were previously ignored or forgotten. • **Example:** The historian's new book helped revive interest in old matters of medieval history. 142:T99b, The correct answer is: **Option 3**.
